about: Corrections to @2003scape/rsc-data rows, applied once at require time by data-fixes.js. Every entry needs a source (Open-RSC Core-Framework Java file and line, or the live evidence). file is the rsc-data json (skills/cooking = node_modules/@2003scape/rsc-data/skills/cooking.json); file shops is the shop stock (shops.json, read by model/shop.js; audited against the authentic Open-RSC shops by scripts/audit/shops-vs-openrsc.js in Autonomous-RSC); path is dot separated, numbers index arrays. ops: set (assign value), delete (remove the key), push (append each of values that is not already there). test/rsc-data-sanity.test.js fails when an entry no longer differs from the raw rsc-data row, so a fix that rsc-data adopts gets removed.

rsc-data lists respawn times only for the 292 npcs that can die; the 4th plague sheep above was one; a quest plugin that takes any other npc out of the world (Clivet rafting off in The Hazeel Cult, the Lost City leprechaun vanishing) left it gone until a restart, so every later player was stuck. Open-RSC respawns every npc (Npc.remove, respawnTime per npc def): those times fill the gaps, rsc-data rows are kept
